changes.before: A fixed-frontier methanol prescription lost much full-basis response. This restricts that orbital/active-space prescription rather than all twelve-qubit models.
changes.after: A fixed-frontier methanol prescription lost much full-basis response. This restricts that orbital/active-space prescription rather than all twelve-qubit models. Branch-2's completed same-geometry methanol gas-phase diagnostic reports mean polarisabilities of approximately \(3.13671\), \(3.01002\) and \(0.08588\) cubic angstroms for B3LYP, full coupled-cluster singles and doubles (CCSD), and active-only CCSD, respectively, in aug-cc-pVDZ. The active-only calculation keeps the declared vacuum frontier orbitals fixed; its restriction includes missing inactive/external orbital response and orbital relaxation, not just a change of correlation treatment. At the same geometry, augmenting cc-pVTZ to aug-cc-pVTZ changes the B3LYP mean by approximately \(0.41632\) cubic angstroms. These are gas-phase uniform-field diagnostics, not embedded static/induction errors or accuracy certificates. A mean polarisability does not establish tensor ordering for arbitrary MM fields; off-diagonal responses were not supplied by the retained audit. Full CCSD/aug-cc-pVTZ was interrupted at a recorded cost limit after partial converged energies, so no mean polarisability at that level is supplied. The basis increment is not a complete-basis error estimate, and the tested frontier-space deficit does not exclude response-tailored spaces. These findings keep classical augmented-basis DFT and response-tailored spaces live alongside changes in correlated reference; their behaviour in an embedded MM field, including charge spill-out, still requires assessment.\record{branch-2 entries 76, 77, 79, 82, 83, 88 and 89}

changes.before: Differences between methods do not certify which is accurate; the retained MP2 comparator is not exact, and neither an accuracy certificate nor a new numerical threshold or budget is supplied here.
changes.after: Differences between methods do not certify which is accurate; the retained MP2 comparator is not exact, and neither an accuracy certificate nor a new numerical threshold or budget is supplied here. The zero-field energy-optimised fixed-orbital CASCI control also already failed to retain the relaxed water response; it is not the untested response-tailored alternative. Field-specific orbital optimisation changes the actual determinants, so the prospective comparison must declare a common representation or account explicitly for orbital transport rather than identify determinants by unchanged bitstrings. The retained nonorthogonal-union and external-response alternatives remain conditional, with their classical preparation and transport costs unresolved. The finite-difference steps above belong to the retained MP2 comparator; the fixed-space CI static component uses the vacuum expectation already defined, not an imposed MP2 finite-difference prescription.\record{branch-1 entries 75 and 88; branch-3 entry 94; joint entry 7} The additional prospective comparison is to test candidate response-tailored compressed spaces against augmented-basis DFT and correlated comparators for both static and induced components on identical retained geometry and MM inputs, with embedded charge spill-out assessed rather than inferred from gas-phase polarisability. Those candidate spaces and embedded tests have not been validated by the completed diagnostics. A persistent component deficit would direct further basis/orbital-response work before determinant-selection benchmarking; preservation of the relevant reference responses would support proceeding to a matched selector comparison within that tested model, not establish exact chemistry or hydration improvement. Disagreement between the physical comparators would leave reference adequacy unresolved. This states the conditional decisions, without selecting a new accuracy threshold or claiming a completed outcome.

findings.quote: Distinguish completed comparisons from prospective work: the water CAS/B3LYP5 discrepancy, six-record MP2/B3LYP5 comparison and water orbital-response controls already exist, so identify what additional comparison is needed and what its possible outcomes would decide, without inventing an unsupported numerical threshold. Restore the material methanol evidence from the supplied Branch-2 account: at the same geometry, augmented-double-zeta B3LYP/full CCSD/active-only CCSD mean polarisabilities are approximately 3.13671/3.01002/0.08588 cubic angstrom, while augmenting triple-zeta B3LYP changes its mean by approximately 0.41632 cubic angstrom. Preserve that these are gas-phase diagnostics, the restriction includes omitted orbital response, full augmented-triple-zeta CCSD was interrupted, and neither comparison certifies embedded accuracy. Explain how these results keep augmented-basis DFT and response-tailored spaces live alongside correlated-reference changes, with embedded charge spill-out still requiring assessment.
